line.name: Deadwood Dominicana Buenas Noches
line.description: DECODE: 'Dom-Noche-Gor' = Dominicana Buenas Noches Gordo. 'Dominicana' is a distinct sub-line departing from Deadwood's usual Nicaraguan-tobacco blends toward Dominican-puro-oriented tobacco. Revealed as the mystery cigar at a 2025 'Freestyle Live' event.

research_notes: Full blend composition (wrapper/binder/filler) and factory not found in sources checked - left null rather than guessed.
